Run az account show --subscription ACCOUNT --output json --only-show-errors. Require exact JSON object required id/tenantId/user{name,type}; id/tenant/name/type equal config, state Enabled, environmentName AzureCloud. Preserve unknown metadata privately only if nonsecret.

Run az account get-access-token --subscription ACCOUNT --resource https://api.fabric.microsoft.com --output json --only-show-errors. Do not use --tenant together unless selected tested CLI profile semantics explicitly support it; selected subscription already fixes tenant. Require tokenType Bearer, nonempty bounded header-safe accessToken, tenant exact, subscription exact, expires_on canonical integer or integer-text POSIX expiry. Never infer cryptographic identity from JWT decode.

Repeat account show immediately after token acquisition and at closing; require same exact selected account tuple. These checks prove tool-reported selection correspondence under the trusted installed credentialtool runtime, not signature validation or token-user cryptographic authentication. Fabric TLS endpoint validates bearer access and permission.

routes.202_rules: Initial202 requires bounded unique Location and x-ms-operation-id canonical UUID with exactmatching state route; no userinfo/port/fragment/encodedslash/query/trailingpath/otherorigin. Record O solely from this actual accepted response. Poll only derived same O routes. Successful state may supply matching result Location; validate against derived /v1/operations/O/result, never redirect-follow. Conflicting official sample omitting /v1 is not broadened silently; actual subset must qualify.

polling: One monotonic deadline begins before authentication; every subprocess/socket read/poll delay uses remaining budget; total bodybytes and requestcount include initial202, all state/error/result bodies.

Retry-After accept bounded decimal integer seconds only. If delay cannot fit remaining interval, refuse finite incomplete observation. No semantic retries, refresh/restart or automatic capacity intervention.

State NotStarted/Running consumes only bounded finite polling; Succeeded retrieves result; Failed/Cancelled or unknown state refuse preserving raw failure. GQL02000 emptytable+nextPage polling remains separate existing wire semantic.

Disable HTTP redirects entirely; read max remainingbodycap+1, label overflow prefix, close every HTTPError/response. Reject unsolicited compression or explicitly bounded decoding if supported later. Use default TLS verification and disable ambient proxy routing under this profile.
contract_text: A Fabric HTTP owner MUST bind one explicitly selected supported AzureCLI delegated-user runtime/configuration/account/tenant, acquire bearer credentials only through that actual tool and retain them in memory. Tool output and decoded token claims MUST NOT substitute for cryptographic token authentication or publication authority. Exact typed finite capacities apply to credential capture, every response, total requests/bytes and elapsed interval including operation polling. The owner MUST accept only its fixed selected GQL/getDefinition routes and operation routes derived from the actual matching202 response, reject redirects and foreign Location targets, retain bounded failure prefixes honestly, and attempt independent credential/runtime closing on all outcomes. No caller token, no-op policy, login/grant, refresh/provisioning or engine activation is created by this owner.
